objective: Explain why breadth has stable incremental association with MFE but a weaker terminal-return association by separating opportunity formation, early path, winner conversion, adverse path, peak giveback, and exit lineage.

sample.primary_cohort: entry-signal date/year/quarter for mechanism attribution; exit year remains the Phase 1 realized-P&L reconciliation convention
sample.missingness: pairwise/endpoint deletion; no imputation and no zero-filling of short holding paths

breadth_state.formula: equal-weight mean of each component's within-entry-year percentile rank, requiring all three
breadth_state.coarse_bins: pooled feature-only terciles of the composite rank; duplicate edges fail closed
breadth_state.purpose: attribution only; not a strategy threshold

fixed_outcome_definitions.capture_ratio: round_trip_return / mfe only for opportunity20 cycles; no clipping

analyses.opportunity: breadth composite Spearman/terciles versus MFE and opportunity20/50
analyses.early_path: return_5d/10d/20d and MAE by breadth tercile; horizon remains missing when a frozen path ends earlier
analyses.conversion: within opportunity20 and opportunity50, breadth versus conversion rate, capture ratio, giveback, realized return, and exit lineage
analyses.adverse_path: breadth versus MAE, false-breakout, severe-loss and extreme-loss rates
analyses.exit_lineage: canonical frozen exit reason by opportunity status and breadth tercile; descriptive selection only, never causal exit effect
analyses.entry_cohorts: fixed entry-year and entry-quarter counts, breadth, MFE, realized return, opportunity/conversion/severe-loss rates

falsification.loyo: Full-sample and omit-one-entry-year estimates for opportunity, conversion, giveback, capture, false-breakout, and severe-loss endpoints
falsification.entry_opportunity_support: breadth composite rho >= 0.10 for MFE or opportunity20 and same positive sign in >=7/8 LOYO estimates
falsification.conversion_support: within opportunity20, breadth absolute rho >= 0.10 for conversion20, capture ratio, or giveback with >=7/8 same-direction LOYO estimates
falsification.H8_entry_primary: entry-opportunity support passes while conversion support fails; otherwise H8 remains qualified/ambiguous
falsification.exit_secondary: may be claimed only descriptively; no counterfactual post-exit path is available

forbidden: new replay or post-exit price use
exit counterfactual or causal exit claim
